title: Crystal system setup
action: Set up the H3N–BF3 crystal system with space group Pbca and 8 complexes per unit cell using the provided experimental lattice constants and fractional coordinates. Generate all molecules (NH3 and BF3 treated as rigid bodies) within a 20 Å cut-off via symmetry operations.
description: Initial crystal structure generation and molecule listing.

title: HF/3-21+G lattice energy routine (polarization + pair energies)
action: Implement the HF/3-21+G lattice energy evaluation: (i) iteratively solve HF for each unique molecule under electrostatic potential from surrounding Mulliken charges until self-consistency; (ii) compute dimer pair energies for all unique pairs within the cut-off, correcting for double-counted polarization; (iii) assemble the total HF lattice energy as sum of one-body (deformation + polarization) and half the sum of pair energies. This routine will be used during optimization.
description: Core HF lattice energy subroutine including many-body polarization.

title: Crystal packing optimization at HF/3-21+G
action: Optimize the lattice constants a, b, c and the B–N bond length (via the N–B distance in the asymmetric unit) by minimizing the total HF lattice energy using a gradient-free optimizer (e.g., Nelder-Mead). During each evaluation, regenerate the crystal from the current parameters, compute the HF lattice energy via the routine from step 2, and return the total energy.

title: Final MP2 lattice energy and pair interaction energies
action: Using the optimized crystal structure from step 3, compute the final lattice energy at the MP2/6-311+G* level. For each unique dimer pair within the 20 Å cut-off, perform a counterpoise-corrected MP2 calculation and assemble the total MP2 lattice energy and the pair energy components. Report the seven major pair energies for pairs (1)-(2) through (1)-(8) as defined in the instruction. Write all results to /app/outputs/results.json.
description: Final scored artifact containing all reproduction targets.
